text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that Sakura Bakushin O is
absent with
stomach pain. She said she
would be better in no
time, but I wonder
if she's okay...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it is because I'm thinking about
her, but I
get the feeling Sakura
Bakushin O is about to
appear in front of
me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? Isn't it obvious? My
stomach
ache subsided so I came to
school!
choice_data_list: って、何してるんだバクシンオー！
って、何してるのバクシンオー！

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It'd be terrible if the class representative
didn't
attend... Owww.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm just hungry, that's all! It's definitely
not a
stomachache!
choice_data_list: やっぱり治ってないんじゃ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She clearly hasn't recovered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She clearly hasn't recovered.
choice_data_list: 寮に帰らないとダメだ
寮に帰らないとダメだよ
みんなを心配させてもいいのか？
みんなを心配させてもいいの？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her to rest up, but...
choice_data_list: 寮に帰らないとダメだ
寮に帰らないとダメだよ
みんなを心配させてもいいのか？
みんなを心配させてもいいの？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I refuse! Everyone in class is waiting for
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Say what you like, but I'm going to class!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKU... SHIIIN! Owww...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Clutching the side of her stomach,
Sakura
Bakushin O dashes off to her
homeroom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's just about to reach for the
classroom door
as I catch up to her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I refuse! As the class representative, I
have duties
to attend to!
choice_data_list: ストップ！寮に帰るぞ！
ストップ！寮に帰るよ！

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
That was great! You did so good as
substitute
class representative!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Voices coming from the classroom cause
Sakura
Bakushin O to stop in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Did I really?

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
For real, for real! You were the perfect
class rep!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Come on, you're flattering me too much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"The perfect... class rep"? Does that
mean I'm no
longer needed?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to her sickness, Sakura
Bakushin O's
voice sounds almost timid.
The students' words
must've added
insult to injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: そんなことない、見てみなよ
そんなことない、見てみて

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
But... it does feel lonely without Baku,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's so quiet without her shouting

BAKUSHIN!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
It's hard work being a representative.
Baku is
amazing, being able to work like
that every day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: E-everyone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! It seems I'm still needed as class

representative!
choice_data_list: ほら言っただろ？
ほら言ったでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Don't worry, I will continue
on in my
role!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly stop the extremely emotional
Sakura
Bakushin O from rushing into the
classroom.
Instead, I make her return to
the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Tracen Academy sees
the return
of the energetic class
representative as she goes
about her
duties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she pushes herself now, her symptoms
may
worsen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I advise her that it isn't wise for a class

representative to make everyone worry...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nngh... I suppose you're right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My actions this time weren't becoming of
a model
class representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll head back to the dorm for... now...
Urgh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-yes. Sorry...
choice_data_list: 一旦、保健室で休もう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O's sickness seems to
be rearing
its ugly head again, so I take
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Awww... I hope everyone in class is okay.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't forgive myself if something
happened
because of my absence...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's fine and all, but as class
representative, I
can't help but worry
about the class.
choice_data_list: まずは体を治すことに専念しよう

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If... I'm not there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bed-ridden Sakura Bakushin O
finally falls
asleep, but she continues to
fret about her
classmates up to the
moment she drifts off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quietly exit the infirmary, being careful
not to
wake Sakura Bakushin O.
choice_data_list: ……代わりにクラスの様子を見てくるか
……代わりにクラスの様子を見てこようか

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ungh...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you awake, Baku?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you all here?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer told us that you came to
school.

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Here! Some tea to help you get back on
your feet!
Get well soon, okay?

text_block_list.name: Classmate D
text_block_list.text:
It's no fun when Baku isn't here! We
need our class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you so much! I'll have to
recover from
this stomachache as soon as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's go, Trainer! Let's train this
pesky
stomach pain away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Intense training offsets intense pain...
right?
choice_data_list: はい！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, her classmates and I have to
stop
Sakura Bakushin O from getting up
and running
out.
choice_data_list: 全然違う……！
